user.title: B-Logicx gateway
user.description: Connect to your BL-NWM (or compatible) gateway on the local network.

error.invalid_host: That does not look like a valid IP address or hostname.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the gateway. Check the IP, port, and that Home Assistant can reach the device.

init.title: B-Logicx
init.description:
Configured bus entries: {entry_count}.

Add or change bus members below. Use Edit or Remove to pick an existing entry. YAML import replaces all entries.

add_address.title: What do you want to add?
add_address.description: Sfeer rooms are added separately (menu: Add Sfeer room).

add_normal.title: Add switch / SoftM
add_normal.description:
One bus address as a Home Assistant switch.

SoftM tracking: Home Assistant answers Toggle/Status/Timer on the bus for this address. Use Set/Reset as on/off commands (not Toggle). Do not also enable “ask on startup”, and do not use a hardware BL-STA on the same address.

data.name: Name
data.check_status: Ask the bus for current on/off when Home Assistant starts
data.enable_softm_status_tracking: SoftM status tracking (Home Assistant answers Toggle/Status)
data.softm_timer: SoftM timer (seconds; 0 = off). After a Timer command, turn on then auto off.
data.persist_state: Remember SoftM on/off across Home Assistant restarts
data.default_state: If nothing was remembered, start SoftM as on

add_rtc.title: Add RTC (bus clock)
add_rtc.description:
Keeps the bus clock in sync (default address 1.1) by writing the time with Program sequences.

Default: every 12 hours at minute :17 (not on the hour). Startup sync runs after other status queries. DST sync waits a short delay after the clock change.

data.name: Name
data.sync_minute: Sync at this minute past the hour (avoid 0)
data.sync_on_startup: Sync when the integration starts (after status queries)
data.dst_delay_minutes: Minutes to wait after a DST change before syncing

add_ldm.title: Add LDM (light sensor)
add_ldm.description:
Outdoor/indoor light sensor on the bus. Levels also arrive on their own when the sensor updates.

If “read on startup” is on, Home Assistant requests a reading at start and adds a Refresh button.

data.name: Name
data.check_status: Read light level when Home Assistant starts (also adds a Refresh button)

add_tsm.title: Add TSM (temperature)
add_tsm.description:
Thermostat / temperature module. Readings include measured temperature, active preset and setpoint.

If “read on startup” is on, Home Assistant requests a reading at start and adds a Refresh button.

data.name: Name
data.check_status: Read temperature when Home Assistant starts (also adds a Refresh button)

add_shutter.title: Add cover (roller / shutter)
add_shutter.description: A cover uses two bus addresses: one for open, one for close. Travel times only estimate when Home Assistant shows open or closed — they do not drive the motors.

data.name: Name
data.check_status: Ask the bus which relay is on when Home Assistant starts

add_sfeer_room.title: Add Sfeer room

data.check_status: Ask the bus which Sfeer is active when Home Assistant starts

add_sfeer_mood.title: Add Sfeer — choose room
add_sfeer_mood.description: Pick the room (bus group). Next you will enter the Sfeer name and address (usually 221, 222, …).

add_sfeer_mood_details.title: Add Sfeer
add_sfeer_mood_details.description: Room “{room_name}” uses bus group {group}. All Sfeer in that room share this group; addresses are usually 221, 222, …

edit_select.title: Edit entry
edit_select.description: Choose which bus entry to edit. The list is sorted by group, then address.

remove_select.title: Remove entry
remove_select.description: Choose which bus entry to remove. The list is sorted by group, then address.

import_yaml.title: Import from YAML
import_yaml.description:
Warning: this replaces ALL existing bus entries.

Upload a YAML file that matches the template (an `addresses:` list).

download_yaml_template.title: Download YAML template
download_yaml_template.description:
Copy the template below into a file (for example `addresses.yaml`), edit it, then use Import from YAML.

{template}

integration_settings.title: Integration settings
integration_settings.description:
SoftM tracking (master switch): when enabled, Home Assistant can answer Toggle/Status for addresses that also have SoftM tracking turned on. Do not use a hardware BL-STA on those same addresses.

Bus repeater: Home Assistant keeps the single gateway link and listens on this host (default port 10001) so BLConfig or blxmonitor on the same LAN subnet can share the bus. Point those tools at the Home Assistant IP, not the gateway IP.

add_readonly.title: Add read-only address
add_readonly.description: Like a normal bus address, but Home Assistant never sends control commands. It only watches Set/Reset (and may ask for on/off at startup). Useful for inputs or any address you want to observe without controlling.

data.name: Name
data.check_status: Ask the bus for current on/off when Home Assistant starts

error.invalid_yaml: Could not read or parse the YAML file.
error.invalid_format: The YAML structure or one or more entries is invalid.
error.softm_check_conflict: SoftM tracking already answers Status for this address. Turn off “Ask the bus … when Home Assistant starts”. Also skip SoftM tracking here if a hardware BL-STA already tracks this SoftM.
error.softm_command_conflict: SoftM tracking answers Toggle on the bus. Set “Command to turn on” to Set and “Command to turn off” to Reset — other commands (such as Toggle) would flip the SoftM twice.
